scope: Repeatable SHELL-0 QA baseline (capture-server mode, --no-sandbox, warm page cache, small fixtures). Evidence for later comparison under equivalent methodology -- not a golden file, not an end-user performance claim, and never asserted byte-for-byte or numerically by CI.

method.pidPolicy: Process ids are file-wide first-seen ordinals (p1, p2, ...), not OS pids.
method.harness: VisualQaRunner + WRL_FORGE_CAPTURE_SERVER (existing world / keyboard.goto / keyboard.executeJS jobs)
method.clock: performance.timeOrigin + performance.now() in both processes (epoch ms, same machine)
method.memorySource: /proc/<pid>/status VmRSS + /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup Pss over the Electron process tree
